# Open Peeps

Illustrations: **Open Peeps** by Pablo Stanley — https://www.openpeeps.com
License: CC0 1.0 (public domain). "You can copy, modify, distribute, remix, burn, and use the work, even for commercial purposes, without asking permission."

The `peeps` files were taken from the npm package `react-peeps` (v0.1.10, MIT wrapper by Emre Çakır — https://github.com/CeamKrier/react-peeps),
which packages the artwork as React components. Colors are applied at runtime via the `strokeColor` / `backgroundColor` slots.
